_note: Fixed startup sequence. 'type' distinguishes a static splash (GFX/ key, rendered via SplashImageLoader) from a video (AVI/ path, played via VideoPlayer/FFmpeg).

steps.note: LOGOSGFX contains 2 images across 4 TP frames, not 1 - see SplashImageLoader's imageIndex param. imageIndex 0 is this (main menu background); imageIndex 1 is the multiplayer/settings/credits background (see role 'secondary_menu_background' below). CD/GFX/CREDITS.TXT holds the credits text entries.
Used for multiplayer, settings, and credits screens.

afterBoot: Main menu, then chapter briefing backgrounds / level manifest (see LevelManifest.json)
